notes.title: New in Chex Quest HD: Co-Op Mode
notes.content:
We’ve updated Chex Quest HD with new features + content! 

[b]Co-Op Mode[/b]: 
Battle waves of Flemoids with 1 to 4 players - how long can you last? 

[b]Character Abilities[/b]:
In Versus and Co-op modes, each CQ squad member now features a unique special ability:
[list]
[*] [u]Fred Chexter[/u]: [i]“I Packed a Snack!”[/i]: Spawn 1 water and a bowl of CHEX MIX
[*] [u]Wheatney Chexworth[/u]: [i]“Increased Chexterity”[/i]: Temporary ability to move faster and jump higher
[*] [u]Dr. O Ryen[/u]: [i]“The Ghost in Ghost Pepper”[/i]: Temporarily become invisible - Flemoids will not attack you
[*] [u]NACL96[/u]: [i]“A Few Spare Parts”[/i]: Drop some armor to share with the team
[*] [u]P.R.E.T.Z.L.[/u]: [i]“G.U.A.R.D.I.A.N. Protocol”[/i]: Create a temporary, impenetrable wall
[*] [u]Shane ‘The Dread’ McBread[/u]: [i]“Fastest Zorcher in the West”[/i]: For a limited time, shoot without consuming ammo
[/list]
[b]Updated Character Stats[/b]:
In Versus and Co-Op modes, each member of the team has re-adjusted stats, to encourage and enable different types of complementary play styles. 

[b]Achievements[/b]: We've added six achievements to the game.

[b]New Music Track[/b]:
Exclusive new CO-OP track by original Chex Quest composer Andrew Benson and Street Cleaner.

notes.title: Chex Quest HD: v111637 Patch
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b]: We've fixed a Steam configuration issue which was preventing installation of the Mac OS version of the game. 

We've released an update, which addresses a handful of issues (see below). 

[b]ADJUSTMENTS + ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] A Mac OS version of the game is now available
[*] HUD size has been reduced in single-player to make more of the world visible
[*] An option has been added to the Main Menu that enables toggling Head Bob on/off
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some players to get stuck in the ship at the end of level 1
[*] Fixed an issue with audio lines being cut off on pick up, or death
[*] Fixed unusual Shane looking animations, firing animations for some weapons
[*] Fixed an issue causing some players to get stuck under the moving platform at the beginning of level 2
[*] Several other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]
